findings.title: 1 class(es) have too few instances to train or validate
findings.detail: Under-represented classes do not simply score badly, they make the headline mAP misleading: a class with two validation instances moves the average by whole points on a single detection. Decide up front whether to merge, drop or collect more of these.
evidence: 'bowl' (id 6): only 2 instances in train; 992x rarer than the most common class; only 0 instances in val, so its per-class mAP is not meaningful
